title: 重复盘中推进与重复隔夜上涨的同日条件比较
designExposure: Earlier twelve fixed candidates have completed; prior outcomes informed this new hypothesis. No actual session-decomposition features, signal population or outcomes have been inspected for parameter selection. This is not a pristine independent test.

sample.meaning: The unchanged original local-file sample is incomplete as a historical whole-market universe. All sample rows are retained regardless of eligibility or future results. The separately recovered 56 stocks are not appended.

sourceBinding.usage: Only audited baseEligibility and per-row date/symbol/source identity are consumed. No prior candidate, Q, leader rank or outcome enters this rule.

baseEligibility.source: audited panel baseEligibility with original causal prefix fallback
baseEligibility.missingCompactValues: Known hard rejections exclude. Compact amount/amplitude rejection labels without explicit numeric evidence remain unevaluable, still non-triggering. Do not invent values or upgrade missing historical identity.

rule.window: T-20..T aligned to all frozen exchange-session slots; cannot skip missing bars; OHLCV finite positive with valid envelope; historical explicit halt is unevaluable, positive-volume halt contradiction also unevaluable.
rule.amountWindow: T-20..T-1 exactly twenty explicit finite positive amounts; arithmetic statistics.mean. Current T amount not in this ranking feature.
rule.decomposition: For j=T-19..T: intraday_j=log(C_j/O_j), overnight_j=log(O_j/C_j-1). I=math.fsum(intraday_j), O=math.fsum(overnight_j); L=math.log(C_T/C_T-20). Retain I+O-L residual. No clipping of negative components or shares above one.
rule.drawdown: Across all 21 closes including T-20: running peak, max Decimal(peak-close)/Decimal(peak) converted to float. Local Decimal context precision28, ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Return threshold uses same local context.
rule.efficiency: L/math.fsum(abs(log(C_j/C_j-1)) for all twenty intervals), or zero for a constant path. Direct binary floating comparisons, no tuned epsilon.
rule.intraday: I >= (2/3)*L and count(C_j>O_j)>=12; Python (2/3) float coefficient.
rule.overnight: O >= (2/3)*L and count(O_j>C_j-1)>=12; these are repeated overnight advances, not necessarily concentrated gaps.
rule.unknown: Required missing or invalid inputs remain unevaluable before applying shape conditions; no fabricated zeros.
rule.emission: Evaluate each T independently, no cooldown/state/first-breakout or prior strategy predicate.

selection.rank: All intraday class by prior20MeanAmount descending then symbol ascending; Top5 before matching and active exclusions.
selection.anchorRetention: All Top5 remain strategy signals even unmatched; never backfill rank six.
selection.controlPool: All same-day overnight-class stocks. Greedy without replacement in fixed anchor rank order; no active position input.
selection.distance: sum(absL/.05,absDD/.05,absEfficiency/.15,log(maxAmount/minAmount)/log(2)); smallest then symbol ascending. Direct max/min<=2 preserves inclusive ratio boundary; other calipers direct float<=.
selection.noRematching: No replacement on unmatched anchor, active suppression or unfilled entry. No global maximum-cardinality optimization.
selection.pairRecords: Every original Top5 anchor has pairId, mate or unmatched reason, distance, differences, feasible unused count; preserve later both-side disposition, including suppression and unfilled.

eventPolicy.entry: one next-exchange-session open attempt; frozen T-close quantity; existing daily opening capacity/limit proxies and T+1 sell lock
eventPolicy.active: Separate empty active map per group; filled event remains until net-target opening proxy or cutoff. Exit at T open releases T-close signal. Unfilled does not reserve. No backfill.
eventPolicy.costs: Reuse registered config/engine cost and slippage assumptions unchanged, not complete historical fee certification. Known static transfer-fee history gap retained.

requiredReports: matched-at-signal pair universe with both-side admission/unfilled/suppressed/unknown
cutoff waiting and target time conditional on observed hits
audit.comparability: Full anchor group must not be directly compared with its partial matched-control group as evidence of superiority. The presignal matched subset is descriptive, not a randomized causal comparison; never select only pairs where both later filled.
audit.source: Exact original physical hashes, manifest/audit, raw dataset fingerprint and complete-content hash, symbols/calendar/counts before and after. No source workspace writes.
audit.lifecycle: Freeze after synthetic tests and review; one real attempt; preserve failure, refuse silent retry or changed artifacts; successful reuse verifies only.
audit.implementation: Archive complete runtime dependencies, registration, pure rule, runner and tests before real evaluation. Independent postrun formula/selection/arithmetic checks before claiming results.

limitations: Repeated open-to-close gains do not reveal the intraday trajectory, operator identity or capital flows.
Unadjusted prior close across corporate actions can distort overnight decomposition and signed shares. No-rights data does not prove no actions.
Fixed local survivor-biased universe, historical eligibility gaps, current reused development period and overlapping events cannot certify future probability.
Matched total path features are joint consequences of the components; the comparison is conditional association, not an identified causal effect.
Historical costs, corporate-action economic returns and executable auction fills remain unverified.

methodEvidence.title: SSE historical exchange rule: ex-rights reference replaces displayed previous close
methodEvidence.scope: Historical primary reference for comparability caveat, not certification of complete current rules or this source history.
